strings.zh: 亲爱的,{NEWLINE}达郎跟咱们分开的时候还太小,{CLEAR}看这个样子似乎是跟袋龙一起长大的。{CLEAR}所以他不记得咱们了也很正常。
strings.en: Dear, Taro was still so little when we{NEWLINE}got separated.{SCROLL}From the looks of it, he grew up with{NEWLINE}the Kangaskhan. It’s only natural he{CLEAR}doesn’t remember us.

strings.zh: 那可怎么办啊老公……
strings.en: Then what do we do, honey...

strings.zh: 没关系,{NEWLINE}咱们就在这里陪着达郎一起生活,{CLEAR}直到他接受咱们为止。
strings.en: It’s all right. We’ll live right here with{NEWLINE}Taro until he accepts us.

strings.zh: 嗯！好！
strings.en: Mm! OK!

strings.zh: 达郎,爸爸妈妈以后{NEWLINE}就在这里陪着你了好不好？{CLEAR}在这里跟你一起生活,{CLEAR}再也不分开了！
strings.en: Taro, Mommy and Daddy are going to stay{NEWLINE}here with you from now on, OK?{SCROLL}We’ll live here with you and never be{NEWLINE}apart again!

strings.zh: 达达达……{NEWLINE}达达？{CLEAR}达！
strings.en: Dadada... Dada? Da!

strings.zh: 快看,亲爱的,{NEWLINE}达郎刚才好像笑了！
strings.en: Look, dear! I think Taro just smiled!

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……太好了！{NEWLINE}真的是太好了！
strings.en: *sob*... That’s wonderful! Truly{NEWLINE}wonderful!

strings.zh: 我们夫妻决定在这里陪伴达郎,{NEWLINE}只要能看到达郎健康快乐地长大,{CLEAR}什么都无所谓了！
strings.en: My husband and I have decided to stay{NEWLINE}here with Taro.{SCROLL}As long as we can watch him grow up{NEWLINE}happy and healthy, that’s all we need!

strings.zh: 想不到跟达郎失散这么多年后,{NEWLINE}居然还能重逢！{CLEAR}我和丈夫以后都会在这里陪伴达郎,{CLEAR}再也不跟达郎分开了。
strings.en: Who’d have thought we’d find Taro again{NEWLINE}after being apart all these years!{SCROLL}My husband and I will stay here with{NEWLINE}Taro and never be apart from him again.

strings.zh: 谢谢你！如果不是你的帮忙,{NEWLINE}我们也不可能在这里和达郎重逢。{CLEAR}为了表示谢意,请你收下这个吧！
strings.en: Thank you!{SCROLL}Without your help, we’d never have been{NEWLINE}reunited with Taro here.{SCROLL}As thanks, please take this!

strings.zh: 达达,达达达……
strings.en: Dada, dadada...

strings.zh: 前方口袋妖怪生态保护区,{NEWLINE}严禁任何人翻越围栏,{CLEAR}违者必究！
strings.en: Pokémon ecological preserve ahead.{SCROLL}Climbing the fence is strictly{NEWLINE}prohibited.{SCROLL}Violators will be prosecuted!

strings.zh: 我是阿桔大人的三大弟子之一,{NEWLINE}擅长使用蛇形精灵,{CLEAR}你想跟我比试一下吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’m one of Master Koga’s three top{NEWLINE}disciples. I specialize in snake Pokémon.{SCROLL}Want to have a match with me?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 嘿嘿嘿,被我吓到了吗？
strings.en: Heh heh heh, did I scare you?

strings.zh: 小心被毒死哦。
strings.en: Careful you don’t get poisoned to{NEWLINE}death.

strings.zh: 你的战术很有意思,{NEWLINE}我要好好研究一下。
strings.en: Your tactics are interesting. I’ll have{NEWLINE}to study them closely.

strings.zh: 饭匙蛇『Se——vip！
strings.en: Seviper: Se-vip!

strings.zh: 我跟着阿桔大人{NEWLINE}学了一段时间的毒系技能,{CLEAR}但是觉得那种技能实在是不适合我。{CLEAR}所以转而研究该怎么治好中毒的精灵。{SCROLL}你现在需要我帮你救治一下精灵吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I studied Poison-type moves under{NEWLINE}Master Koga for a while, but they really{CLEAR}weren’t for me.{SCROLL}So I switched to studying how to cure{NEWLINE}poisoned Pokémon.{SCROLL}Do you need me to treat your Pokémon?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 如果有需要,随时可以来找我。
strings.en: If you ever need me, come see me{NEWLINE}anytime.

strings.zh: 你的精灵已经达到最佳状态了哦。
strings.en: Your Pokémon are in perfect condition.

strings.zh: 幸福蛋『Bliii——sey！
strings.en: Blissey: Bliii-sey!

strings.zh: 虽然我拜在阿桔老师门下学习,{NEWLINE}但是比起忍术修行来,{CLEAR}我还是更喜欢看女忍者们的美丽身姿。{CLEAR}久而久之我悟出了一个{CLEAR}专门吸引异性的禁忌忍术。{CLEAR}你想学吗？
strings.en: I may be studying under Master Koga,{NEWLINE}but I prefer watching the lovely figures{CLEAR}of the kunoichi to ninja training.{SCROLL}Over time, I came up with a forbidden{NEWLINE}jutsu made especially for attracting{CLEAR}the opposite sex.{SCROLL}Want to learn it?
strings.notes: #184-#187: pervy ninja apprentice (TM for an attraction move); innuendo kept (D-0627). 情热天堂 → 'Make-Out Paradise' (Naruto's Icha Icha Paradise, official English title).

strings.zh: 你对异性都没有兴趣吗？
strings.en: You’re not interested in the opposite{NEWLINE}sex at all?

strings.zh: 看你那副色色的样子{NEWLINE}真是跟我一模一样。{CLEAR}我的忍术都写在这张技能机里了,{CLEAR}你好好读读吧！
strings.en: That pervy look on your face is just{NEWLINE}like mine.{SCROLL}My jutsu is all written in this TM.{SCROLL}Study it well!

strings.zh: 只发明这种色色的技能机{NEWLINE}并不能满足我,{CLEAR}我准备把自己的想法写成一本书,{CLEAR}叫什么好呢……{CLEAR}对了,就叫「情热天堂」吧！
strings.en: Just inventing pervy TMs like this isn’t{NEWLINE}enough for me. I’m going to write my{CLEAR}ideas down in a book.{SCROLL}What should I call it... I know!{NEWLINE}‘Make-Out Paradise’!

strings.zh: 毒骷蛙『Toxiii——croa！
strings.en: Toxicroak: Toxiii-croa!

strings.zh: 赤焰松『哼,果然如此。
strings.en: Maxie: Hmph. Just as I thought.

strings.zh: 阿桔『居然能看穿我的忍术,{NEWLINE}看来你们火箭队也不是等闲之辈嘛。
strings.en: Koga: You saw through my jutsu.{SCROLL}It seems Team Rocket is no ordinary{NEWLINE}bunch either.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『阿桔馆主,小瞧我们火箭队{NEWLINE}就是你今天的致命失误。
strings.en: Ariana: Gym Leader Koga,{NEWLINE}underestimating Team Rocket was your{CLEAR}fatal mistake today.

strings.zh: 阿桔『确实变得棘手起来了……
strings.en: Koga: This has indeed become tricky...

strings.zh: 阿桔『那位叫{VAR:0103:0}的少年,{NEWLINE}你应该还有能战斗的精灵吧？{CLEAR}过来帮我一下。
strings.en: Koga: You, the boy called {VAR:0103:0}. You{NEWLINE}should still have Pokémon that can{CLEAR}fight, yes?{SCROLL}Come and help me.

strings.zh: 阿桔『那位叫{VAR:0103:0}的女孩,{NEWLINE}你应该还有能战斗的精灵吧？{CLEAR}过来帮我一下。
strings.en: Koga: You, the girl called {VAR:0103:0}. You{NEWLINE}should still have Pokémon that can{CLEAR}fight, yes?{SCROLL}Come and help me.
{VAR:0103:0}: Ah, right!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『真是垂死挣扎,{NEWLINE}你以为带上两个小鬼就能打赢我们？{SCROLL}雅典娜『赤焰松、水吾桐,{NEWLINE}跟我一起拿下他们的脑袋。
strings.en: Ariana: What a desperate struggle. You{NEWLINE}think bringing two brats along will let{CLEAR}you beat us?{SCROLL}Ariana: Maxie, Archie, take their heads{NEWLINE}with me.

strings.zh: 阿桔『咻——咻咻——
strings.en: Koga: Fweeet- fweet-fweet-

strings.zh: 雅典娜『……？
strings.en: Ariana: ...?

strings.zh: 水吾桐『好嘞,我想亲自下手很久了！
strings.en: Archie: You got it! I’ve been itching to{NEWLINE}do this myself for ages!

strings.zh: 赤焰松『小鬼,你现在后悔已经晚了,{NEWLINE}纳命来吧！
strings.en: Maxie: Too late for regrets now, brat.{NEWLINE}Prepare to die!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『了不起啊,阿桔馆主,{NEWLINE}居然能挡住我的全力攻击。{CLEAR}但是那两个小鬼已经快撑不住了,{CLEAR}你们马上就要完蛋了！
strings.en: Ariana: Impressive, Gym Leader Koga,{NEWLINE}blocking my all-out attack.{SCROLL}But those two brats are about to{NEWLINE}collapse. You’re all finished!

strings.zh: 阿桔『我们？{NEWLINE}嘿嘿,我们可不只是这点人哦。
strings.en: Koga: Finished, are we? Heh heh. There{NEWLINE}are more of us than this.
strings.notes: RV003: grammar: 我们？ echoes Ariana's 你们马上就要完蛋了; 'All?' did not read

strings.zh: 阿桔馆主,{NEWLINE}我们听到您的哨声就赶过来了。
strings.en: Gym Leader Koga, we heard your whistle{NEWLINE}and came running.

strings.zh: 这伙人是盗猎者吗？
strings.en: Are these people poachers?

strings.zh: 我们这就帮您逮捕这群罪犯！
strings.en: We’ll arrest these criminals for you{NEWLINE}right away!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『原来刚刚的口哨{NEWLINE}是在呼叫增援。
strings.en: Ariana: So that whistle was a call for{NEWLINE}backup.

strings.zh: 赤焰松『碍事的家伙渐渐多起来了……
strings.en: Maxie: The nuisances keep multiplying...

strings.zh: 水吾桐『咱们没带手下啊,{NEWLINE}还要继续战斗吗？
strings.en: Archie: We didn’t bring any grunts. Do{NEWLINE}we keep fighting?

strings.zh: 赤焰松『真是可惜。
strings.en: Maxie: What a pity.

strings.zh: 水吾桐『切,让这群垃圾捡条命。
strings.en: Archie: Tch. This trash gets to live{NEWLINE}another day.

strings.zh: 您身上只带着一只精灵,{NEWLINE}双打的话请至少带两只精灵来。
strings.en: You only have one Pokémon with you.{SCROLL}For a Double Battle, please bring at{NEWLINE}least two.
